    if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == "LassoLarsIC":

    calls["pre"].append(copy_X)
    Xc, yc = X.copy(), y.copy() if copy_X else (X, y)
    return Xc, yc, np.zeros(X.shape[1]), 0.0, np.ones(X.shape[1])

def lars_path(X, y, Gram=None, copy_X=True, copy_Gram=True, alpha_min=0.0,
              method='lasso', verbose=0, max_iter=500, eps=1e-8,
              return_n_iter=False, positive=False):

    alphas = np.array([1.0, 0.5, 0.1])
    coefs = np.zeros((2, 3))
    return alphas, [0, 1], coefs, 2

class LinearModel:

e3 = Est(); e3.copy_X = True
fit(e3, X, y, copy_X=False)
assert calls["pre"] == [False] and calls["lars"] == [False], calls

# 4) init copy_X=False, fit(copy_X=True) -> explicit fit arg wins
e4 = Est(); e4.copy_X = False
fit(e4, X, y, copy_X=True)
assert calls["pre"] == [True] and calls["lars"] == [True], calls

# 5) signature default is None, not True

sig = inspect.signature(fit)
assert sig.parameters["copy_X"].default is None, sig
